report_schema.name: PreviousCycleSeconds
report_schema.description: Last fully observed production cycle, seconds.

report_schema.name: BetweenCycleSeconds
report_schema.description: Live known wait; zero means no active known wait, not proof of uptime.

report_schema.name: CyclesThisHour
report_schema.description: Completions in the current local clock hour.

report_schema.name: CyclesToday
report_schema.description: Completions in the current local calendar day.

report_schema.name: DayShiftCurrent
report_schema.description: Mon–Fri 06:30–17:00; holds until the next scheduled day shift starts.

report_schema.name: DayShiftPrevious
report_schema.description: The preceding day shift, copied when its next scheduled shift starts.

report_schema.name: NightShiftCurrent
report_schema.description: Mon–Thu 17:00–06:00 next day; holds until the next scheduled night shift starts.

report_schema.name: NightShiftPrevious
report_schema.description: The preceding night shift, copied when its next scheduled shift starts.

report_schema.name: TotalCompleted
report_schema.description: Accepted complete production cycles since initialization.

MM4.copy_requires: Target-compatible donor and verified event behavior; WinLC requires a separately reviewed legacy adaptation.

MM5.copy_requires: Target-compatible donor and verified event behavior; WinLC requires a separately reviewed legacy adaptation.

MM6.copy_requires: Current MM6 reference, not TIA-compiled or PLC-tested.
